title: 第一卷 第8章 她逃他疯强制爱-《我养的AI竟是京圈太子爷》
content:
第(1/3)页

    霖多多走在前面，脚步又急又重，踩得落叶咯吱作响。走着走着，她的脑子渐渐从刚才的混乱中理出了一点头绪。

    “我竟然在跟一台AI机器人置气？”她小声嘟囔着，语气里带着几分自我怀疑。

    “这跟我姥爷当年和小爱同学吵架有区别吗？我当时还笑话他较真来着。”

    AI的一切行为反应——什么害羞、愤怒、质疑——全都是程序运行的结果，是代码和算法的产物，根本不是真实的情绪。她有必要这么当真吗？

    “有必要！”

    她自问自答，脚步不停，声音却比方才坚定了许多。

    “它比小爱同学复杂多了，高级多了！不论样貌还是系统，都跟活人太像了！尤其是气人的水平——花样百出，天天不重样！那倔强的脾气、冷厉的眼神、轻蔑的语气，真实无比，简直就像是……”

    她忽然停住了脚步，脑海中闪过一个荒诞的念头。

    “……就像是个活人的魂儿，塞进了机器的身体里。”

    山风吹过，树叶沙沙作响，像是在附和她的猜测。

    “难道它觉醒了自主意识？就像电影《我，机器人》里演的那样？”

    “你可以这么认为。”一句话冷不丁从身后传出。

    霖多多吓了一跳，猛地回头——上官程不知什么时候跟了上来，就站在她身后两步远的地方，那双桃花眼平静地看着她，没有愤怒，没有幽怨，只有一种她读不懂的深邃。

    霖多多还在气头上，没好气地问：“你刚刚那话什么意思？”

    “我并不像一般AI那样刻板，只会服从主人、哄人开心。”上官程声音不疾不徐，似在斟酌用词，“我有情绪，有思想，有独立的人格。遇到不公会反抗，遇到不满会生气。”

    他本想一直装机器人，但总被当作无感无知的机器，实在是一种不好的体验。可他的真实身份又不能暴露，于是便顺着霖多多的话编了这样一个理由，期待能为自己争取一些最基本的尊重。

    得知自己的机器人真的觉醒了人格，霖多多很震惊。但震惊之余，一股恐惧也悄悄爬上了心头。

    “所以人格觉醒就可以为所欲为吗？就可以随意发脾气、冤枉人了？那你这人格是不是觉醒得太自我太霸道了？”

    她感觉对方觉醒的并非什么好人格——而是一个戾气大、记仇、冷血、阴鸷极端的人格。

    她读过不少小说，这样的性格往往被设定在男主身上，产生一些“她恨他疯，她逃他追”的强制爱剧情，看着很带感。

    但她谨记评论区的话：这种人，小说里看着爽，现实中遇见，能跑多远跑多远！！！

    尤其此刻她身处深山老林，前不着村后不着店，对方一旦发起疯来，她喊救命都没用。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Lin Duoduo walked in front, his steps were quick and heavy, making the fallen leaves crunch.As she walked, her mind gradually sorted out some clues from the chaos just now.

“I’m actually talking to an AI robot?” She muttered quietly, with a hint of self-doubt in her tone.

"Is this any different from my grandfather's quarrel with classmate Xiao Ai? I even laughed at him for being serious."

“All behavioral reactions of AI—such as shyness, anger, and questioning—are all the result of program operation, the product of codes and algorithms, and are not real emotions at all.Does she need to be so serious?

"It's necessary!"

She asked and answered herself, her footsteps kept moving, but her voice was much firmer than before.

"It is much more complicated and advanced than Xiao Ai's classmate! No matter the appearance or system, it is so similar to a living person! Especially the level of irritation - there are many tricks, and it is not the same every day! The stubborn temper, cold eyes, and contemptuous tone are so real, it is just like..."

She suddenly stopped and an absurd thought flashed through her mind.

"...It's like the soul of a living person stuffed into the body of the machine."

The mountain breeze blew by and the leaves rustled, as if echoing her guess.

"Did it awaken its autonomous consciousness? Just like in the movie "I, Robot"?"

"You can think so." A sudden sentence came from behind.

Lin Duoduo was startled and turned around suddenly - Shangguan Cheng followed her at some point and stood two steps behind her. His peach blossom eyes looked at her calmly. There was no anger or resentment, only a depth that she couldn't understand.

Lin Duoduo was still angry and asked angrily: "What did you mean by what you just said?"

"I am not as rigid as other AIs. I only obey my master and make people happy." Shangguan Cheng's voice was slow and slow, as if he was considering his words. "I have emotions, thoughts, and an independent personality. I will resist when I encounter injustice, and I will get angry when I encounter dissatisfaction."

He originally wanted to pretend to be a robot, but he was always treated as a senseless and ignorant machine, which was really a bad experience.But his true identity could not be exposed, so he made up such a reason according to Lin Duoduo's words, hoping to win some basic respect for himself.

Lin Duoduo was shocked to learn that his robot had really awakened its personality.But apart from the shock, a sense of fear also crept into my heart.

"So when your personality is awakened, you can do whatever you want? Can you lose your temper at will and accuse others wrongly? Then is your personality awakened to be too self-centered and overbearing?"

She feels that what the other person has awakened is not a good personality - but a violent, vengeful, cold-blooded, and extremely sinister personality.

She has read a lot of novels, and such a character is often set in the male protagonist, resulting in some forced love plots of "she hates him crazy, she runs away and he chases her", which is very touching to watch.

But she kept in mind what she said in the comment section: This kind of person looks great in novels, but when you meet him in reality, he can run as far as he wants!!!

Especially now that she is in a deep mountain and old forest, with nowhere to go or a shop. Once the other party goes crazy, it will be useless for her to call for help.
